name: Torn Murloc Fin
summary: In eastern Elwynn, Torn Murloc Fins show the Stormwind Army's bounty is being answered. Taken from foragers and lurkers along the riverbanks, they show that local waterways are being systematically cleared.

sections.title: A Bountied Threat
sections.body: Murlocs have grown numerous along eastern Elwynn's streams and lakes, and the Stormwind Army offers a bounty to reduce their numbers. Guard Thomas, who watches the bridge over the eastern river, collects the severed fins as proof of kills. Stormwind's soldiers are stretched thin by unrest at home and threats nearby, so local authorities depend on travelers to bring proof that murloc camps have been cleared.

faq.q: Who buys or collects Torn Murloc Fins?
faq.answer: Guard Thomas collects Torn Murloc Fins at Elwynn Forest's eastern bridge for Marshal Dughan and the Stormwind Army.

faq.q: Where are the murlocs carrying these fins located?
faq.answer: The fins come from murloc foragers and lurkers around Stone Cairn Lake to the north and the southern stream fork near eastern Elwynn's border.

faq.q: Why does Stormwind require fins as proof?
faq.answer: Fins are unmistakable and easy to carry, giving the Stormwind Army physical proof of slain murlocs before it pays the bounty hunters.

faq.q: Why is the Stormwind Army paying for dead murlocs?
faq.answer: Murloc villages have spread quickly along the waterways, threatening travelers, fishermen, and local infrastructure while the Stormwind Army's forces are occupied elsewhere.

angles.text: For the Alliance, clearing eastern Elwynn's waterways protects vital routes between Goldshire, Lakeshire, and Stormwind City.
As a human, you know local authorities rely more and more on mercenaries to protect homesteads and riverbanks from aggressive murloc settlements.
